name: io.github.YOUR_GITHUB/leeway-mcp
description: Policy-guarded on-chain tools for AI agents: risk scans, guarded swaps, tx simulation, x402.

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_HARD_CAP_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap: anything above is denied (default 500)

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated merchants/protocols allowed above the micro allowance

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_EXECUTION_CHAINS
environmentVariables.description: Chains where the agent may sign (default base-sepolia)

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent hot-wallet private key (or run init-wallet)

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Telegram chat id (only this chat can approve)

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_APPROVAL_WEBHOOK
environmentVariables.description: URL that receives approval requests (email via Zapier/Make/n8n/Resend)

environmentVariables.name: LEEWAY_APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for the X-Leeway-Signature header
